notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.
goFirst false: the guide's going-second line is 'the extra DON!! lets the leader drop Wyper OP08-110 on T2' (inference); the general default is to go second (strategy-concepts §10 [S17]).

cardValue: ongoing effects named in the guide's Defining cards (OP12-099's draw engine, Wyper OP15-114's sweep and DON!! gift, Borsalino's Blocker and Life refill, Sweet 3 Generals). The sizes are inferences.
weights.hand 1.1: the deck's engine is cards (OP12-099 draws when Life moves, OP15-101 searches) [SH-KAL]; inference.

counterAggression 1.1: 'every free play costs a Life card' and 'a fast opponent can punish a turn spent playing for value' [guide, inference]; inference: the Life it has left counts for slightly more.
faceBias 1.0/1.0/1.0: the guide gives no stage-dependent race plan; the default is kept.
Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value.
Seed 1 has two parts: the Leader attacks, and it gets a DON!! first, because [DON!! x1] needs one for the free play (the giveDon bias rewards a move that gives the Leader any).
Seed 2 uses targetHighestPower with by 'cost': the free play is the highest-cost legal Shandian Warrior in hand [SH-KAL: 'play the best Shandian Warrior'; guide's reading, inference].

Seed 4 uses playBeforeLeaderAttack: Sweet 3 Generals goes on before the Leader's attack drops Wyper OP15-114, so −3000 and −2000 land on the same Characters. It does not model the guide's DON!! checks (the stack needs 9 DON!! going first at T4/T5); search sees what the DON!! allow.
Seed 5 uses playOnlyIf with 'never': Kingdom Come is never played unless the move wins (a win scores 1000 and outweighs the penalty). The guide says 'keep Kingdom Come for a turn you expect to win'.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; every condition here is public.
